docker.update_command:
bash -c 'set -euo pipefail
ctr_updater_file="$(mktemp)"
trap '"'"'rm -f -- "$ctr_updater_file"'"'"' EXIT
curl --proto =https --tlsv1.2 -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NoobCity99/CTRoadmap/9ba3c494a6a8a64c52a555c74d69af9014958cc9/ctr_update.sh -o "$ctr_updater_file"
printf '"'"'%s  %s\n'"'"' 8ba879f54a9d35fb8ef515076dc4ad18c23ad837991c4b07f138d336500c86b0 "$ctr_updater_file" | sha256sum --check --status
chmod +x "$ctr_updater_file"
bash "$ctr_updater_file"'
docker.notes: Standard Linux release installs: copy this one-time host updater bootstrap command. NAS/Portainer: keep using your platform's native update workflow.
